licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the No. 18 Finale (697 bars) read in fifteen page ranges, sung lines and piano each by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the zoomed page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by nine fresh proofreaders (three fixes on pages 148–154, the rest clean). The German singing translation is left out. All the singers of this section have a staff throughout, with rests where the print leaves a staff out; singers who do not sing in this section are left out. Cut from the one-file finale at bar 62: the first bar of the following Allegro is the last bar here, because the sisters' last syllable “me” falls on its first beat (the same bar opens “Si mora sì, si mora”). Playback tempo ♩ = 60 (Andante) from René Jacobs's recording (harmonia mundi), the last bar at the Allegro's ♩ = 166.
